ledgerMechanics.nodeOwnership: validate-roadmap.mjs requires each unit ownershipPaths entry to exist and to appear verbatim in the owner node's ownershipPaths (string equality, not containment); the P2CF registration was bitten by this. Each track unit's ownershipPaths entry is an exact existing file, except TS7S5C, which owns the change directory it moves. Each entry is listed verbatim in R6.ts7-toolchain.ownershipPaths. Prospective files (the guard test, the canonical spec, the option (b) delta spec) are in the unit's ownershipExceptions, which the validator neither existence-checks nor compares to the node. The --git merge check accepts exact exception matches.
ledgerMechanics.whyNewNode: No existing node owns tsconfig.json, desktop/**, scripts/tsconfig.json, scripts/metrics/validate-refactoring-metrics.js, .storybook/main.ts, README.md, docs/overview.md, openspec/config.yaml, openspec/scripts/** or src/docs/Introduction.mdx. R6.loop-harness owns package.json, .husky and pr-checks.yml, but its acceptance line 1 forbids src/ edits outside its listed amendments, and TS7S1 must edit three src files. Amending it would widen a node that 20+ open units already use.
ledgerMechanics.taskKeys: tasks.md of migrate-to-typescript-7 is not in the admission snapshot or any supplement snapshot, so no task key exists. Every track unit carries taskKeys [] like the P2C* units, and maps to tasks.md through behavior, source20261016.changeTasks and this receipt. A supplement snapshot was rejected (see rejectedAlternatives).
ledgerMechanics.ciClass: Every unit owns at least one path outside openspec/planning/ and docs/, so the derived ciClass is product for all ten.
ledgerMechanics.reviewClasses: routine for all ten: the existing non-sensitive class used by the CI/infra units (U64-U85) that own the same tooling files. TS7S1 touches auth.ts and IdentityService.ts with type-only edits and carries a stop-and-reclassify rule if admission finds a runtime change.
ledgerMechanics.deferralsArray: ledger.deferrals requires non-empty taskKeys and a deferredToNode, which a track with no task keys cannot supply. The OD-next-upgrade and section 6 deferrals are therefore findings with holder and releasePredicate, the shape FN-p2-* findings use for holder.
ledgerMechanics.next: NEXT walks units in ledger order and chooses the first planned unit whose node dependencies are ready and whose paths are free of in-flight units; it ignores predecessors except registration20261016.predecessors. Blocked track units are skipped, so NEXT is unchanged. The units are inserted after P2 and before U38, before the first planned non-chain unit (U24b at index 109 before insertion). So once the parent releases TS7S1 (and P2CG1A2 is terminal), NEXT selects TS7S1 ahead of U24b and the later planned units.
ledgerMechanics.fileCounting: Files per unit = leaves + units.json + admission/red/local receipts + the reserved review slot, as in the P2CF/P2CG1 registrations. Lockfiles count as files; their added lines are uncounted (package-lock.json pattern, which also matches desktop/package-lock.json). Under --no-renames a moved file counts as two files (deleted path and added path) and all of its lines count as added.

overlap.rule: The validator's no-overlap mechanism is NEXT path exclusion against in-flight units (validate-roadmap.mjs, the inFlightPaths check). Units never hold a file at the same time because (1) the parent runs one product-writing lane, (2) every track unit is blocked until released one at a time, and (3) NEXT will not select any planned unit whose paths overlap an in-flight track unit, and the reverse. Every overlap below is serial. No ownershipExceptions, no amendment and no edit to another unit's contract fields is needed or made. An open unit that later edits a file the track changed must measure against the then-current main at its own admission, as the Task 57 rule already requires for U101a/U101d.
overlap.note: package.json is also owned by U12, U63, U75, U80, U83 and U84; .github/workflows/pr-checks.yml by U64, U66, U75 and U81; roadmap-loop-closure-proof.test.ts by U103 and the scripts/__tests__ owners; auth.ts by U101a and U101d and every src/lib/multiplayer/server unit, including P2CG1A2, which is in flight now and must be main-verified before TS7S1 is released, and P2CG1B-P2CG1I4, P2CG2 and P2CH, which stay blocked until after the stopping point. All of them are blocked or planned future units, and none is edited.

scheduling.release: Each release is a one-field state edit (blocked to planned) by the parent, as in the P2C* chain. TS7S2OD also requires the owner's ruling.

rejectedAlternatives.option: One unit per numbered section (5 or 6 units)
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Section 4 is 14 leaves with units.json, 18 files with receipts and the review slot, over the 15-file cap. Section 5's archive move counts about 575 lines, over 500. Sections 2 and 5 also carry inventory gaps that would push them to 15-16 files with no margin.

rejectedAlternatives.option: Merge sections 0-1 with section 2, or 3 with 4
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Breaks the change's rule that sections 1-4 land in order, one PR each. It also mixes a 5.8-valid prep with a compiler bump, and loses the one-revert rollback per phase (D8).

rejectedAlternatives.option: Split section 4 by package (desktop vs root) instead of routing vs swap
rejectedAlternatives.reason: The root half alone is still 16 files with receipts. Routing the gates through npm run typecheck while on the TypeScript 6 bridge leaves every intermediate main consistent: all gates on 6, then all on 7 in one swap.

rejectedAlternatives.option: Track as a machine-readable predecessor of P2CG1B
rejectedAlternatives.reason: The parent rejected it: an open owner decision (TS7S2OD) on the track's tail could then stall the P-chain. The insertion point is text only.

rejectedAlternatives.option: Run the track after P3 exits
rejectedAlternatives.reason: The parent chose a defined stopping point inside the chain. The track edits package.json, the lockfiles, CI, hooks and the roadmap main proof that every unit closure runs, so it needs a quiet single-lane window, which exists between P2CG1A2 and P2CG1B.

rejectedAlternatives.option: Run the track in parallel with P2CG1 units
rejectedAlternatives.reason: Violates the single product-writing lane rule. TS7S4B also edits roadmap-main-proof.mjs and roadmap-loop-closure-proof.test.ts, which every unit closure runs.
Its acceptance forbids src/ edits outside listed amendments. It lacks tsconfig.json, desktop/**, docs and openspec paths, and widening it would grant those paths to 20+ unrelated open units.

rejectedAlternatives.option: Supplement snapshot of the change's tasks.md (U42) so units hold real task keys
rejectedAlternatives.reason: It activates the package under the holders rule and pins tasks.md bytes that the units must edit (ticks, outcome lines). Section 6 is plain text, not checkboxes. taskKeys [] with explicit changeTasks mapping matches the P2C* precedent the parent named.

rejectedAlternatives.option: ledger.deferrals entries for OD-next-upgrade and section 6
rejectedAlternatives.reason: The validator requires non-empty taskKeys and deferredToNode for a deferral, and there is no task key. Findings with holder and releasePredicate carry the same information.
